priorityList: Charge into combat and use Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Apply and maintain Rend on all targets, using Thunder Clap to refresh the debuff if it has less than 8 seconds remaining.
Cast Sweeping Strikes whenever it is not active, especially if the Broad Strokes talent is not taken.
Activate Avatar and Champion's Spear together for your primary burst window.
Use Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) to apply the damage vulnerability debuff to enemies.
Cast Ravager while Colossus Smash is active on your targets.
Use Cleave as your primary priority in AoE situations to hit multiple targets.
Cast Bladestorm while Colossus Smash is active to maximize its damage output.
Use Execute on Sudden Death procs or if targets are in the execute phase (below 20% health, or 35% if using Massacre).
In the execute phase, cast Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or if Colossus Smash is active.
Use Whirlwind if you have the Fervor of Battle talent, prioritizing use when at 3 stacks of Collateral Damage.
Cast Overpower to generate Rage and stacks of Dreadnaught or Opportunist.
Use Mortal Strike to maintain Deep Wounds and spend Rage if Cleave is unavailable.
Activate racial abilities (like Blood Fury or Berserking) and DPS trinkets during the Colossus Smash window.
Use Slam as a low-priority filler if you have excess Rage and no other abilities are available.
